name: Generated version source file
reachedBy: Redirected echo output written to PolicyPlus\Version.vb, which is not among the analysed files.
membershipRule: The path held in variable VF in version.bat (PolicyPlus\Version.vb).

name: Git command line
reachedBy: The batch file runs the git program from the developer shell.
membershipRule: The command git describe --always run from version.bat.

name: Windows registry
reachedBy: The .NET registry classes (RegistryKey, RegistryHive) opening a hive and a subkey of the current machine.
membershipRule: RegistryKey.OpenBaseKey, CreateSubKey, GetValue and SetValue calls; resource is the subkey the caller names.

name: Microsoft Download Center
reachedBy: The ADMX download dialog fetches an MSI package over HTTPS with the .NET WebClient.
membershipRule: The URL held in constant MicrosoftMsiDownloadLink (https://download.microsoft.com/...), fetched with Net.WebClient.DownloadFile.

name: Windows Installer (msiexec)
reachedBy: The program starts the msiexec process to unpack the downloaded MSI into a folder.
membershipRule: A Process.Start of msiexec with arguments /a, /quiet, /qn and TARGETDIR.

name: Local file system, including policy definition and comment files
reachedBy: Direct .NET System.IO and XmlDocument calls on local folders and files: the ADMX, ADML and CMTX policy files and their folders, the scratch folder under %localappdata% and the destination folder the person picks.
membershipRule: XmlDocument.Load or Save of a path, and Directory, File and access-control calls on local folders: the ADMX and ADML policy folders (resource is the XML root element read or written, or the folder or path probed), paths under %localappdata%\PolicyPlusAdmxDownload, and the destination folder the person picks, all reached through System.IO.

name: Windows Forms and .NET class library
reachedBy: Dialogs call framework members to show windows, pop up message boxes and ask for a save path; there is no source for them in scope.
membershipRule: Calls to ShowDialog, MsgBox, SaveFileDialog and base-class members such as TreeView.WndProc; the resource is the member called.

name: Windows system libraries
reachedBy: The program declares functions of user32, userenv, advapi32 and kernel32 with Declare statements and calls them directly.
membershipRule: Every Declare Lib statement in PInvoke.vb; the resource is the function name as declared.

name: Windows account database
reachedBy: The user dialog asks Windows to translate an account name to its security identifier with the .NET NTAccount class.
membershipRule: NTAccount.Translate to SecurityIdentifier in OpenUserGpo.vb; the resource is the account name typed by the person.
